description: Get the currently authenticated GitLab user.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the current user object (id, username, name, email, state, is_admin, ...); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List all users known to the GitLab instance.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of user objects (id, username, name, email, state, is_admin, created_at); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List projects, optionally filtered by visibility.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of project objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single project by its numeric id.

project_id.description: The numeric id of the project.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the project object; on failure (project not found), output contains an error message.

description: List issues for a project, optionally filtered by state and labels.

project_id.description: The numeric id of the project.

state.description: Optional issue state filter ('opened', 'closed', or 'all'). 'all' returns every state.

labels.description: Optional comma-separated list of labels; issues matching any of the labels are returned.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of issue objects sorted by updated_at descending; on failure (project not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single issue by project id and issue iid.

project_id.description: The numeric id of the project.

issue_iid.description: The internal id (iid) of the issue within the project.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the issue object; on failure (project or issue not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new issue in a project.

project_id.description: The numeric id of the project.

description.description: Optional free-text description for the issue.

assignee.description: Optional username to assign the issue to.

labels.description: Optional list of label strings to attach to the issue.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created issue object; on failure (project not found), output contains an error message.

description: Update fields of an existing issue, or close/reopen it.

project_id.description: The numeric id of the project.

issue_iid.description: The internal id (iid) of the issue within the project.

title.description: Optional new title for the issue.

description.description: Optional new description for the issue.

state_event.description: Optional state transition: 'close' to close the issue or 'reopen' to reopen it.

labels.description: Optional new list of label strings for the issue.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated issue object; on failure (project or issue not found), output contains an error message.

description: List merge requests for a project, optionally filtered by state.

project_id.description: The numeric id of the project.

state.description: Optional merge request state filter ('opened', 'merged', 'closed', or 'all').

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of merge request objects sorted by updated_at descending; on failure (project not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new merge request in a project.

project_id.description: The numeric id of the project.

title.description: The title of the merge request.

source_branch.description: The source branch of the merge request.

target_branch.description: The target branch of the merge request (default 'main').

description.description: Optional free-text description for the merge request.

assignee.description: Optional username to assign the merge request to.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created merge request object; on failure (project not found), output contains an error message.

description: Merge an existing merge request by project id and merge request iid.

project_id.description: The numeric id of the project.

mr_iid.description: The internal id (iid) of the merge request within the project.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the merged merge request object; on failure (not found, draft, cannot be merged, or already merged), output contains an error message.

description: List pipelines for a project, optionally filtered by status.

project_id.description: The numeric id of the project.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of pipeline objects sorted by created_at descending; on failure (project not found), output contains an error message.
